remaining_nonblocking_observations: Very deep flow YAML can trigger the parser's RESOURCE_EXHAUSTION error before the checker's post-parse depth measurement. It returns invalid_yaml/2 and blocks saving, rather than asserting a measured checker limit/3.
When formulas are invalid, summary_missing may be skipped with the incomplete-reference branch; the known invalid result still blocks saving.
The private npm test script runs verify.cjs, which is repository-only and requires docs data. This is not the documented installed runtime path.
